dead_letters_failures.headline: 9 dead-letter classes are visible.

items.plain_summary: A package request could not be parsed into a valid request shape.
A request is missing a required workflow, package, or target field.
A request asked for protected authority such as send, submit, ledger, provider, or paid truth.
A request referenced a workflow OpenClaw does not currently route.
A response appears older than the current package/read-model state.
A local read model exists but the expected bridge copy is missing.
A service may be running older code than the committed local route.
A local or bridge write requires operator-granted filesystem permission.
A provider action requires an explicit provider gate and operator approval.

dead_letters_failures.summary: Malformed, stale, unsafe, or missing-file requests can be inspected without retries or provider calls.

executive_summary.headline: OpenClaw has a local teamroom and governance backbone.
executive_summary.plain_text: Track A gives the teamroom path a review, handoff, staging, backlog, and Workroom question backbone. Track B gives protected gates, approvals, dead letters, artifact lineage, evidence confidence, memory promotion, lane graduation, cutover status, and an end-to-end smoke plan. Business actions remain gated.

memory_candidates_needing_promotion.headline: 8 memory candidates are waiting at the promotion gate.

items.summary: Finance / St. Anne's should use a dedicated thread so work-log intake and month-end invoice questions do not blur together.
Helm should be action desk, not proof wall; show one current action and keep proof collapsed unless asked.
Capital Hilton Coupa invoice numbers cannot use hyphen; Coupa normalized 2026-1006 into 2026 1006.
Cassandra can lead homecoming-style briefings in plain language, with short Chief/Hermes/Guardian inserts.
When competing safe next moves exist, prefer active unresolved review items, then Capital Hilton payment watch, then workboard review.
Capital Hilton is a payment-watch lane after Coupa Processing; ledger remains untouched until payment proof arrives.
Mac Excel helper permissions are unstable for St. Anne's; do not rely on helper OPEN_WORKBOOK as the only export path.
Proof should be collapsed unless asked; decide later which proof details become operator-visible by default.
